cases.name: type-no-focus
cases.html:
<!DOCTYPE html><style>body{margin:0;font:16px Arial}.abs{position:absolute}</style><input id=a class=abs style='left:10px;top:10px;width:60px'><script>
var log = [];
function L(s) { log.push(s); }
function nm(t) { return t === window ? 'window' : t === document ? 'document' : (t.id || t.nodeName); }
function d(e) {
  var s = e.type + '@' + nm(e.target);
  if (e.relatedTarget) s += '<' + nm(e.relatedTarget);
  return s;
}
var MODS = /^(Control|Shift|Alt|Meta)$/;
function watch(types, extra, opts) {
  types.forEach(function (t) {
    document.addEventListener(t, function (e) {
      if (e.type.startsWith('key') && MODS.test(e.key)) return;
      L(extra ? d(e) + ' ' + extra(e) : d(e));
    }, opts || true);
  });
}
function watchWin(types) {
  types.forEach(function (t) {
    window.addEventListener(t, function (e) { if (e.target === window) L(d(e)); }, true);
  });
}
function em(e) {
  return 'c=' + e.clientX + ',' + e.clientY + ' b=' + e.button + '/' + e.buttons + ' d=' + e.detail;
}
function ek(e) {
  return 'key=' + JSON.stringify(e.key) + ' code=' + e.code + ' kc=' + e.keyCode + ' cc=' + e.charCode +
    ' loc=' + e.location + ' rep=' + e.repeat + ' sh=' + e.shiftKey + ' ct=' + e.ctrlKey;
}
function ei(e) {
  return 'it=' + e.inputType + ' data=' + JSON.stringify(e.data) + ' c=' + e.cancelable + ' b=' + e.bubbles +
    ' comp=' + e.isComposing + ' ' + e.constructor.name;
}
function flush() { return log.join('|'); }
</script><script>watch(['keydown', 'keypress', 'keyup', 'beforeinput', 'input'], function (e) { return e.type.startsWith('key') ? 'key=' + e.key : ''; });</script>
